status: User-approved pattern definitions; research implementation, no live activation
primaryDesign: Frozen before any new returns computed
rules: All eight explicitly approved examples are executable unit-test cases.
direction: First-to-current money-share change fixes allowed direction. Window counterflow can damp or cancel but cannot reverse it. No static money-ticket-gap feature.
timing: Money, tickets and signed price are compared on each same pair of adjacent, synchronized snapshots strictly before tipoff. A price move in an earlier interval does not confirm money arriving in a later interval.
progression: Continuous share-change magnitudes and relative ticket changes; log1p line confirmation; opposing price damped by 1/(1+log1p(abs(move))).

fitting.algorithm: nonnegative ridge, four features, no intercept
fitting.chronology: Earlier ET slate dates only; additionally require training tipoff+6 hours before earliest evaluation decision. Exact settlement times are unavailable.

cohort: Recaptured saved public boards and independently matching ESPN finals, Nov 8-22. Use reconstructible, captured baseline benchmarks available by each saved pregame market decision. Original workspace archive is inaccessible; report any coverage difference rather than substituting a different benchmark.
evaluation: same games and quotes for baseline and correction
limitations: Baseline and B-band were selected using overlapping earlier research; replay remains exploratory.
Shares are provider sample percentages, not absolute dollar inflows.
Same-interval observations establish timing alignment, not a causal explanation of a price move.
